ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV Rust encryptor execution via --access-token / --propagated CLI flags
ucs.description: Hunts the BlackCat (ALPHV / Noberus) Rust ransomware binary at execution. The encryptor is gated by a mandatory 32-byte hex access token passed as --access-token and uses a distinctive flag set (--no-prop, --propagated, --child, --bypass, --paths, --drag-and-drop, --ui) that the operator must supply on the command line. This combination is essentially unique to BlackCat across the ransomware ecosystem (Microsoft tracks the families under Storm-0875 / FIN7 affiliate UNC4466 / Scattered Spider deployments such as MGM-Caesars).
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.process_hash) as hash values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*--access-token*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop*" OR Processes.process="*--propagated*" OR Processes.process="*--child*" OR Processes.process="*--bypass*") AND Processes.user!="*$" by host Processes.user Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval token_match=if(match(cmd,"(?i)--access-token[=\s]+[0-9a-f]{32,}"),1,0)
| eval flag_combo=if(match(cmd,"(?i)--(no-prop|propagated|child)") AND match(cmd,"(?i)--(paths|drag-and-drop|ui)"),1,0)
| where token_match=1 OR flag_combo=1
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV (Noberus) Rust encryptor execution
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--access-token","--no-prop","--propagated","--child","--bypass")
| extend TokenMatch  = iff(ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token[=\s]+[0-9a-f]{32,}", true, false)
| extend FlagCombo   = iff(ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--(no-prop|propagated|child)" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--(paths|drag-and-drop|ui)", true, false)
| where TokenMatch or FlagCombo
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV (Noberus) Rust encryptor execution — Sysmon/4688
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" and TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine has_any ("--access-token","--no-prop","--propagated","--child","--bypass")
| extend TokenMatch = iff(CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token[=\s]+[0-9a-f]{32,}", true, false)
| extend FlagCombo  = iff(CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--(no-prop|propagated|child)" and CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--(paths|drag-and-drop|ui)", true, false)
| where TokenMatch or FlagCombo
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = TargetUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackCat ALPHV Ransomware Execution Flags
id: 7c2a4d8e-3b41-4f17-8a52-bca0c4f3d2e7
status: experimental
description: Detects BlackCat/ALPHV (Noberus) Rust encryptor command-line argument set (--access-token plus propagation/UI/path flags) characteristic of this family
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/06/13/the-many-lives-of-blackcat-ransomware/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/unc4466-blackcat-veeam
author: detection-eng
date: 2026/06/05
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  token:
    CommandLine|re|i: '--access-token[=\s]+[0-9a-f]{32,}'
  flag_combo_a:
    CommandLine|contains|all|i:
      - '--'
    CommandLine|re|i: '--(no-prop|propagated|child)'
  flag_combo_b:
    CommandLine|re|i: '--(paths|drag-and-drop|ui)'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (token or (flag_combo_a and flag_combo_b)) and not filter_machine
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Highly unlikely; --access-token followed by 32+ hex chars is BlackCat-specific
level: critical
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@CommandLine:*--access-token* OR @CommandLine:*--no-prop* OR @CommandLine:*--propagated* OR @CommandLine:*--child* OR @CommandLine:*--bypass*) AND (@CommandLine:*--paths* OR @CommandLine:*--drag-and-drop* OR @CommandLine:*--ui* OR @CommandLine:*--access-token*) -@User:*$

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| regex("(?i)--(access-token|no-prop|propagated|child|bypass)", field=CommandLine)
| TokenMatch := if(regex("(?i)--access-token[=\s]+[0-9a-f]{32,}", field=CommandLine), "1", "0")
| FlagCombo  := if(regex("(?i)--(no-prop|propagated|child)", field=CommandLine) AND regex("(?i)--(paths|drag-and-drop|ui)", field=CommandLine), "1", "0")
| TokenMatch="1" OR FlagCombo="1"

Mandiant (UNC4466) and Microsoft (Storm-0875) both call out the exact --no-prop / --propagated / --child / --paths / --drag-and-drop / --ui set as a BlackCat fingerprint. ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat pre-encryption staging chain: safe-boot + shadow-copy wipe + Defender disable
ucs.description: Hunts the BlackCat operator playbook in the minutes before detonation: forcing a safe-mode reboot via bcdedit, wiping VSS shadow copies via vssadmin or wmic shadowcopy, and disabling Microsoft Defender via Set-MpPreference. Microsoft (Storm-0875) and Sophos have documented BlackCat affiliates running this exact three-pronged staging sequence to defeat EDR, rollback, and recovery — the combination is far stronger signal than any individual command.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*bcdedit*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*wmic*shadowcopy*delete*" OR (Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*" AND Processes.process="*Disable*Monitoring*" AND Processes.process="*$true*")) AND Processes.user!="*$" by _time host Processes.user Processes.process Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval technique=case(match(process,"(?i)bcdedit.*(safeboot|recoveryenabled)"),"SafeBootOrRecoveryOff",
                     match(process,"(?i)(vssadmin.*delete.*shadows|wmic.*shadowcopy.*delete)"),"ShadowDelete",
                     match(process,"(?i)Set-MpPreference.*Disable.*Monitoring"),"DefenderDisable")
| bin _time span=1h
| stats values(process) as commands values(technique) as techniques dc(technique) as tech_count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by host user _time
| where tech_count >= 2
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV pre-encryption staging: safe-boot + VSS wipe + Defender disable within 1h on same host
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (ProcessCommandLine has "bcdedit"  and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled"))
     or (ProcessCommandLine has "vssadmin" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
     or (ProcessCommandLine has "wmic"     and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (ProcessCommandLine has "Set-MpPreference" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("DisableRealtimeMonitoring","DisableBehaviorMonitoring","DisableScriptScanning","DisableIOAVProtection") and ProcessCommandLine has "$true")
| extend Technique = case(
    ProcessCommandLine has "bcdedit", "SafeBootOrRecoveryOff",
    ProcessCommandLine has "vssadmin" or ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy", "ShadowDelete",
    ProcessCommandLine has "MpPreference", "DefenderDisable",
    "Other")
| summarize Techniques = make_set(Technique),
            SampleCommands = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 5),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), Events = count()
        by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where array_length(Techniques) >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
